items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Fletcher Henderson was at the Grand Terrace, $35 a week, with John Kirby on bass, trumpet player.

ctx.x: That’s right. And Fletcher Henderson was at the Grand Terrace, $35 a week, with John Kirby on bass, trumpet player.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was one of John Kirby‟s. If you notice on John Kirby‟s records he uses a lot of pedal points... I tried to observe that, to learn…

ctx.x: It was one of the worst and most frightening things that ever happened. Billy was… I had heard Billy with…
Kirby, and man, I‟m looking, I‟m saying, “Oh, man this guy has beautiful touch”.
